item.title: Full Stack Web Developer (Freelance)
item.description: OdontoSystem is a multi-tenant enterprise healthcare SaaS platform designed to manage multiple dental clinics. It features role-based access control and hierarchical permissions for administrators, receptionists, dentists, and patients. The platform also includes financial management tools for administrators and dentists, with comprehensive financial statistics and in-depth reporting.

item.description: Freelancing using various web technologies. Maintenance of web systems and private servers for online multiplayer games. Development of web systems and games in general. Rainbet BlackJack is an original game from the Rainbet casino, which I began developing. item.title: NFT Game Developer and Full Stack Web Developer (Full-Time)
item.description:
Solstead Surreal World is a Web-based NFT social multiplayer online game with gameplay similar to Club Penguin, where the player has an NFT character and can purchase NFT land within a metaverse.

Note: The Solstead Surreal World that I developed has been archived, and its code base was reused to create Solstead Arcade games.
